notes.title: Yogscast Jingle Jam 2019
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Super happy to announce that Border Force has just been revealed as one of the games in day 8 of the Jingle Jam! This means that you can go get a copy of Border Force and many other awesome games for a $30 donation to charity over at www.humble.com/yogs

We hope to see many new players and we hope you all enjoy it. As always our Discord is at https://discord.gg/frtKefZ - we're always around for any questions or a chat. :)

The team @ Spire

PS Check out Space Force!!

notes.title: Space Force DLC Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're super excited to launch our first full DLC for Border Force - Space Force!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188780/Border_Force_Space_Force_DLC/

We've been working long, long hours to create this and we really hope you like it. It has a brand new campaign with more playtime than the base game, a new multiplayer level, and a range of new space-based features!

To celebrate our first full expansion Border Force will be 50% off for the next 3 days, with Space Force being 10% off for the first week. 

SPACE FORCE

+ Low gravity!
+ New campaign!
+ New multiplayer map!
+ New achievements!
+ More!

Bug fixes & updates to EU/UK & US/Mexico

+ New options menu: everything is now configurable.
+ Controller support & rebind-able controls.
+ New sounds & music added courtesy of [url=https://twitter.com/HarriRMSlater]Harrison Slater![/url]
+ Fixed an issue where the Day 5 achievement on US/Mexico wasn't unlocking.
+ Scoring feedback added to Multiplayer: you can now see what's contributing to your score as you play.
+ Optimisations made to US/Mexico scene.
+ Sound effects added to all contraband items.
+ Free play modes added for EU/UK, US/Mexico & Space Force.
+ Bug fixes across both singleplayer & multiplayer levels.
+ Network tweaks for smoother multiplayer performance.



We really hope you like it! Keep your eyes and ears peeled for news, playthroughs and competitions!

A reminder that our Discord can be found at https://discord.gg/frtKefZ - it helps for arranging multiplayer sessions!

Thank you

The team @ Spire Interactive

notes.title: Artwork Competition
notes.notes:
Hi all, two things!

[h1]The Artwork Competition[/h1]

We've added some billboards to the US/Mexico levels and would love some contributions for content to display on them! The requirements are really simple:

[list]
[*] Border Force themed
[*] Not outrageously offensive - use your common sense!
[*] .JPEG format
[*] 2000w x 1000h
[*] Submitted to our Discord channel at [url=https://discord.gg/CPDp9b2]discord.gg/CPDp9b2[/url] before the end of Sunday (14/07)
[/list]

[b]We'd never expect this for nothing so to say thanks we'll be judging the entries for our favourites and awarding first place with 5 keys, second place with 3 keys and third place with 1 key to share with your friends. [/b]

Naturally (and with your permission!) we'll be using your designs in-game in the US/Mexico levels - they'll be there for all to see!

[h1]Various fixes[/h1]

There is also a small update today with some fixes including:

[list]
[*] Materials on certain vehicles in US/Mexico fixed.
[*] Achievement for day 5 of US/Mexico should now unlock correctly.
[*] Corrected some model placements.
[*] Contraband monitors should now display the correct contraband list on certain US/Mexico levels.
[*] Fixed vehicles stopping before leaving when rejected on certain US/Mexico levels.
[/list]

There are still a few more camera-related fixes to come soon.

Have a great week!

Spire Interactive

notes.title: Border Force: US/Mexico now LIVE
notes.notes:
[h1]Border Force: US/Mexico Edition[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P_wPgJTobXY

Hi everyone! 

It is 2020 and time to head to the Mexican border for your new assignment. Following your success as a British border guard you have been requested to assist the US Border Force with their brand new border wall. 

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] A new, larger and fully explorable map set between two outposts on a remote section of the Mexico & US border.
[*] A new 5 day campaign featuring new tasks, objectives and gameplay.
[*] Quadbikes!
[*] A new US/Mexico multiplayer map featuring 2 checkpoints for each team.
[*] Pickup trucks!
[*] New contraband.
[*] More stuff that you'll just have to find.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the US/Mexico update and as always we'd love to hear your feedback, see your streams, videos and reviews. Keep us posted in the discussions. You can also find us on Discord over at [url=https://discord.gg/CPDp9b2] Discord.gg/CPDp9b2 [/url]

[b]A reminder that Border Force is still 50% off for the duration of the Steam Summer Sale, so pass it on![/b]

This update is entirely free content.

A huge thank you from all of us at Spire Interactive

notes.title: US/Mexico Edition & Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Greetings all,

Two things to tell you about today:

[h1]The Steam Summer Sale[/h1]

We're happy to announce that Border Force will have a 50% discount throughout the duration of the summer sale. If you have any friends or enemies who may be interested then please ask them to check it out - or do something nice and gift it even!

[h1]US/Mexico Edition[/h1]

We're even happier to announce that the US/Mexico themed expansion launches on July 4th (during the sale!)

This expansion is totally free & included with Border Force.

The expansion brings a new larger map, a new campaign, and some new features including driving, contraband hunting & even a spot of racing.

There is a trailer you can check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P_wPgJTobXY]here[/url]

See you on the border!

Spire Interactive

PS: You can find our Discord over at [url=https://discord.gg/frtKefZ]discord.gg/frtKefZ[/url]

notes.title: Border Force: Update 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, it's been an exciting week for us and we hope that you are all enjoying Border Force!

Here are a few quick bug fixes and changes relating to issues that a few of you have encountered.

[list]
[*] Score required to finish Day 9 reduced - it should now be easier to complete.
[*] The player model had a thorough eye test and his astigmatism should now be cured - fixed a Depth of Field bug causing excessive blur.
[*] Fixed a time-related bug on Day 3 which was affecting progression.
[*] Various UI fixes.
[*] Added a new time of day variation to the list of possible variations in multiplayer. You'll need your fog lights.
[*] A few other less noticeable tweaks and changes.
[/list]

We'll be keeping an eye on the discussions forum and we'd love to hear your feedback or ideas there!

Have a great week, recruit.

notes.title: Border Force - out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just a quick message to say that Border Force is now released worldwide! It's been a long journey and it's also our first game as a new studio, and we hope that you like it.

We'll be around in the discussions section for any feedback. 

Enjoy!

Spire Interactive
